_meta.note: No test suite was executed by this audit; all counts are from reading test files, not run results.

test_inventory.ai_service_offline_evaluation_harness_fi: not individually counted; separate from Jest count, do not conflate

invariants.statement: Moving a workout session must preserve unrelated sessions
Changing workout frequency must result in the requested session count
Changing a meal must not silently change an unrelated nutrition goal
Changing one client's program must not affect another client
Confirming a stale proposal must not apply outdated changes
Partially completed workflows must accurately report what succeeded
Safety restrictions must survive conversational revisions
invariants.note: most important invariant failure in the audit

invariants.statement: A PT-dashboard query must never require N+1 calls across a client roster
invariants.note: enforced only because the feature that would risk it does not exist yet

invariants.statement: An AI-drafted plan must never be persisted without the owning service's own accept step
A CycleAssessment's AI-authored decision must never be settable by a human reviewer
An unresolvable AI-generated exercise reference must never be silently persisted
